<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Camelias Kids</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#95592A">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Camelias Kids">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: barra superior con el logo en una "etiqueta" de cartón y pestañas; cada pestaña es una mesa de trabajo. Paleta tomada del logo de Camelias Kids: caramelo, rosa y celeste. */
:root{
  --bg:#FBF5F3; --surface:#FFFFFF; --sunk:#F4EAE6; --ink:#3B2A20; --muted:#7A665A; --line:#EADCD5;
  --accent:#95592A; --accent-soft:#F3E3D6; --on-accent:#FFFFFF; --pink:#C4517F; --sky:#3B9DBF; --paper:#FFFFFF;
  --good:#1D7A4C; --good-soft:#DDF1E6; --warn:#A35F00; --warn-soft:#FBEBD2; --bad:#B3261E; --bad-soft:#F8DEDC;
  --f-display:"Fraunces", Georgia, serif;
  --f-body:"Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --r:10px;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#1C1512; --surface:#271E1A; --sunk:#18120F; --ink:#F3E9E2; --muted:#B5A69B; --line:#3B2F28;
  --accent:#E0A06A; --accent-soft:#3A2A1E; --on-accent:#1C1512; --pink:#EE8DB6; --sky:#74C6E2; --paper:#FBF5F0;
  --good:#5BD49A; --good-soft:#163527; --warn:#F2B35E; --warn-soft:#3A2A12; --bad:#FF8A80; --bad-soft:#3D1A18; color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#1C1512; --surface:#271E1A; --sunk:#18120F; --ink:#F3E9E2; --muted:#B5A69B; --line:#3B2F28;
  --accent:#E0A06A; --accent-soft:#3A2A1E; --on-accent:#1C1512; --pink:#EE8DB6; --sky:#74C6E2; --paper:#FBF5F0;
  --good:#5BD49A; --good-soft:#163527; --warn:#F2B35E; --warn-soft:#3A2A12; --bad:#FF8A80; --bad-soft:#3D1A18; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{margin:0}
:root{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--surface)}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
h2{font-size:1.45rem} h3{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600}
.num,.mono{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}

header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding-block:12px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.logo-tag{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:4px 10px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;position:relative}
.logo-tag::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5px;top:50%;width:5px;height:5px;margin-top:-2.5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sky)}
.logo-tag img{height:52px;width:auto;display:block;margin-left:6px}
@media (max-width:600px){.logo-tag img{height:34px}}
.brand .shop{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.today{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.today b{color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:600}
.sync{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.78rem;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;padding:2px 4px}
.sync i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);display:inline-block}
.sync.ok i{background:var(--good)} .sync.off i{background:var(--warn)} .sync.err i{background:var(--bad)}
nav.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;margin-top:8px}
nav.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tab{border:0;background:none;padding:10px 12px 11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tab[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--accent);border-bottom-color:var(--pink)}
.badge{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:.72rem;background:var(--pink);color:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:0 6px;line-height:1.5}

main{padding-block:22px 60px}
section.view{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.vhead{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vhead p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:62ch}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px}
.panel>h3{margin-bottom:12px}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}
.grid{display:grid;gap:12px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr))}
label.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;min-width:0}
label.f.grow{flex:1 1 200px}
.inrow{display:flex;gap:6px}
.inrow input{flex:1}
input,select,textarea{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;min-width:0;width:100%;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;font-size:.95rem}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
input[type=number]{font-family:var(--f-mono)}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.btn.pri{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn.pri:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);color:var(--on-accent)}
.btn.danger{color:var(--bad)} .btn.danger:hover{border-color:var(--bad)}
.btn.sm{padding:5px 9px;font-size:.82rem;border-radius:6px}
.btn.ghost{border-color:transparent;background:none}
.btn.cam{padding:8px 10px;flex:none}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--sunk);border-radius:9px;padding:3px;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{border:0;background:none;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9rem}
th{text-align:left;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;background:var(--sunk)}
td{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
td.r,th.r{text-align:right}
td.num,td.mono{white-space:nowrap}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.pill.good{background:var(--good-soft);color:var(--good)} .pill.warn{background:var(--warn-soft);color:var(--warn)}
.pill.bad{background:var(--bad-soft);color:var(--bad)} .pill.neu{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--muted)}
.empty{padding:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:12px}
.kpi{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.kpi .k{font-size:.74rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.kpi .v{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:1.3rem;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.kpi .s{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi.hero{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.kpi.hero .k,.kpi.hero .s{color:var(--on-accent);opacity:.8}

.pos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 340px;gap:18px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){.pos{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.scanbox{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:var(--surface);border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 6px 6px 14px}
.scanbox>svg{flex:none;color:var(--accent)}
.scanbox input{border:0;font-size:1.1rem;padding:10px 4px;font-family:var(--f-mono)}
.scanbox input:focus{outline:none}
.scanbox .btn.cam{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--accent);padding:10px 14px}
.results{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.res{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;width:100%}
.res:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.qty button{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
.qty span{min-width:22px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--f-mono)}
.till{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 110px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
@media (max-width:860px){.till{position:static}}
.till .line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.till .total{border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.till .total b{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:2rem;font-weight:600}
.cobrar{font-size:1.1rem;padding:14px}
.sold{border:1px solid var(--good);background:var(--good-soft);color:var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px;font-size:.9rem}
.sold b{color:var(--good)}
.item-name{font-weight:600}
.item-sub{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.var-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr 90px 1.6fr 36px;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.var-head{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:620px){.var-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 70px 36px}.var-row .vc{display:none}}
.hint{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-weight:500}
.check input{width:auto}
.chart svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.chart text{fill:var(--muted);font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:10px}
.bars-h{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.bh{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,190px) minmax(0,1fr) 110px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.88rem}
.bh .track{height:10px;background:var(--sunk);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bh .fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:99px}
.bh .val{text-align:right;font-family:var(--f-mono)}

.lbl{background:#fff;color:#000;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;padding:1mm .75mm;line-height:1.05;box-sizing:border-box}
.lbl svg{display:block;flex:0 1 auto;min-height:0}
.lbl .l-code{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;font-size:2.5mm;letter-spacing:.35mm;margin-top:.4mm;white-space:nowrap}
.lbl .l-info{font-size:2.4mm;max-width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:.3mm}
.lbl .l-info b{font-size:2.7mm}
.lbl-stage{background:var(--sunk);border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;overflow:hidden}
.lbl-stage .zoom{transform:scale(2.4);transform-origin:top center;margin-bottom:calc(var(--zh) * 1.4)}
.lbl-stage .lbl{outline:1px dashed #b9a99f;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.sheetmap{display:grid;gap:2px;width:min(170px,100%);aspect-ratio:210/297;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:4px;border-radius:4px}
.sheetmap i{background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:1px;min-height:0}
.sheetmap i.used{background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--line) 0 2px,transparent 2px 4px)}
.sheetmap i.next{background:var(--pink)}
#print{display:none}

.banner{background:var(--warn-soft);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--warn);border-radius:var(--r);padding:10px 14px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.9rem}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,12,25,.55);z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}
.modal-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:14px;max-width:520px;width:100%;max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;z-index:30;max-width:calc(100% - 32px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
#toast.err{background:var(--bad);color:#fff}
.camv{position:relative;background:#000;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3;max-width:100%}
.camv video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.camv .guide{position:absolute;left:8%;right:8%;top:38%;bottom:38%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 0 0 999px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.camv .guide::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4%;right:4%;top:50%;height:2px;background:#ff4d4d}
.camlog{font-size:.85rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;max-height:110px;overflow:auto}
.login{max-width:420px;margin:40px auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.login-logo{background:var(--paper);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.login-logo img{width:min(300px,100%);height:auto}

.login .err{color:var(--bad);font-size:.88rem}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.tab,.btn,.res{transition:color .12s,border-color .12s,background .12s}}
@media print{
  :root{padding:0!important}
  html,body{background:#fff!important}
  body::before{display:none}
  body>*:not(#print){display:none!important}
  #print{display:block!important}
}
</style>
<style id="pageStyle"></style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="hd">
      <div class="brand"><h1 class="sr">Camelias Kids</h1><span class="logo-tag"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Camelias Kids"></span><span class="shop" id="shopName"></span></div>
      <div class="today" id="todayStrip"></div>
    </div>
    <nav class="tabs" id="tabs" aria-label="Secciones"></nav>
  </div>
</header>
<main class="wrap" id="main"></main>
<div id="modal" class="modal" hidden><div class="modal-card" id="modalCard" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"></div></div>
<div id="toast" hidden></div>
<div id="print"></div>

<script>
/* =====================================================================
   CONFIGURACIÓN DE FIREBASE
   Pegá acá la apiKey del proyecto (la misma que usa el Apiario:
   buscá "apiKey" en el index.html del Apiario y copiá el valor).
   ===================================================================== */
const FIREBASE_API_KEY = "AIzaSyA-BEi9GHk8YP-CThOAdBVTKzL83C43sMk";
const FIREBASE_PROJECT = "appicultura-1d603";

(function(){
"use strict";
const LOGO="data:image/webp;base64,";
/* ============ utilidades ============ */
const $=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s);
const $$=(s,r=document)=>[...r.querySelectorAll(s)];
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const numIn=v=>{const n=parseFloat(String(v).replace(',','.'));return isFinite(n)?n:0};
const money=n=>'$ '+Math.round(n||0).toLocaleString('es-AR');
const pct=n=>isFinite(n)?(n*100).toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+' %':'—';
const uid=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8);
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
const dkey=d=>{d=new Date(d);return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())};
const fdate=iso=>new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('es-AR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'2-digit'});
const ftime=iso=>new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('es-AR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
const SIZES=['XXS','XS','S','M','L','XL','XXL','XXXL','U','ÚNICO'];
const sizeOrd=t=>{const u=String(t||'').toUpperCase();const i=SIZES.indexOf(u);if(i>=0)return i;const n=parseFloat(u);return isFinite(n)?100+n:500};
const PAGOS=['Efectivo','Débito','Crédito','Transferencia','Mercado Pago','Otro'];
const CATS=['Remeras','Camisas','Pantalones','Jeans','Buzos','Camperas','Vestidos','Polleras','Deportivo','Ropa interior','Accesorios','Calzado'];
const GCATS=['Alquiler','Sueldos','Servicios','Impuestos','Publicidad','Bolsas y packaging','Otros'];
const LS={get(k,d){try{const v=localStorage.getItem(k);return v==null?d:JSON.parse(v)}catch(e){return d}},set(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch(e){}},del(k){try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}}};

/* ============ Code 128 ============ */
const C128=["212222","222122","222221","121223","121322","131222","122213","122312","132212","221213","221312","231212","112232","122132","122231","113222","123122","123221","223211","221132","221231","213212","223112","312131","311222","321122","321221","312212","322112","322211","212123","212321","232121","111323","131123","131321","112313","132113","132311","211313","231113","231311","112133","112331","132131","113123","113321","133121","313121","211331","231131","213113","213311","213131","311123","311321","331121","312113","312311","332111","314111","221411","431111","111224","111422","121124","121421","141122","141221","112214","112412","122114","122411","142112","142211","241211","221114","413111","241112","134111","111242","121142","121241","114212","124112","124211","411212","421112","421211","212141","214121","412121","111143","111341","131141","114113","114311","411113","411311","113141","114131","311141","411131","211412","211214","211232","2331112"];
function c128(data){
  const vals=[];let start;
  if(/^\d+$/.test(data)&&data.length%2===0){start=105;for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=2)vals.push(+data.substr(i,2));}
  else{start=104;for(const ch of data){const c=ch.charCodeAt(0);if(c<32||c>126)throw new Error('char');vals.push(c-32);}}
  let sum=start;vals.forEach((v,i)=>sum+=v*(i+1));
  return [start,...vals,sum%103,106].map(v=>C128[v]).join('');
}
/* Dibuja el código con ancho de barra fijo en mm, para que la impresora lo saque nítido.
   0,375 mm = 3 puntos exactos en una térmica de 203 dpi. Zona en blanco de 10 barras a cada lado. */
function barcodeSVG(data,maxW,barH,thermal){
  let p;try{p=c128(String(data))}catch(e){return ''}
  const q=10;let x=q,r='';
  for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++){const w=+p[i];if(i%2===0)r+=`<rect x="${x}" width="${w}" height="10"/>`;x+=w;}
  const M=x+q;const opts=thermal?[.375,.25]:[.375,.33,.3,.25];
  const mod=opts.find(m=>M*m<=maxW)||maxW/M;const W=+(M*mod).toFixed(3);
  return `<svg width="${W}mm" height="${barH}mm" viewBox="0 0 ${M} 10" preserveAspectRatio="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="${M}" height="10" fill="#fff"/><g fill="#000">${r}</g></svg>`;
}

/* ============ Firebase (REST, igual que el Apiario) ============ */
const EP=Object.assign({fs:'https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1',idt:'https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1',sec:'https://securetoken.googleapis.com/v1'},window.PERCHA_ENDPOINTS||{});
const COLS={items:'tienda_items',ventas:'tienda_ventas',movs:'tienda_movs',gastos:'tienda_gastos',cola:'tienda_cola'};
const META='tienda_meta/config';
const apiKey=()=>(FIREBASE_API_KEY&&!FIREBASE_API_KEY.startsWith('PEGAR'))?FIREBASE_API_KEY:LS.get('percha_apikey','');
const docPath=p=>`projects/${FIREBASE_PROJECT}/databases/(default)/documents/${p}`;
const fsUrl=s=>`${EP.fs}/projects/${FIREBASE_PROJECT}/databases/(default)/documents${s}`;
let auth=LS.get('percha_auth',null);

function enc(v){
  if(v===null||v===undefined)return{nullValue:null};
  if(typeof v==='boolean')return{booleanValue:v};
  if(typeof v==='number')return Number.isInteger(v)?{integerValue:String(v)}:{doubleValue:v};
  if(typeof v==='string')return{stringValue:v};
  if(Array.isArray(v))return{arrayValue:{values:v.map(enc)}};
  return{mapValue:{fields:encF(v)}};
}
const encF=o=>{const f={};for(const k in o){if(o[k]!==undefined)f[k]=enc(o[k])}return f};
function dec(v){
  if('stringValue' in v)return v.stringValue;
  if('integerValue' in v)return Number(v.integerValue);
  if('doubleValue' in v)return v.doubleValue;
  if('booleanValue' in v)return v.booleanValue;
  if('timestampValue' in v)return v.timestampValue;
  if('arrayValue' in v)return(v.arrayValue.values||[]).map(dec);
  if('mapValue' in v)return decF(v.mapValue.fields||{});
  return null;
}
const decF=f=>{const o={};for(const k in f)o[k]=dec(f[k]);return o};
const tsNorm=t=>{if(!t)return'';return t.replace(/(\.\d+)?Z$/,m=>{const d=(m.match(/\d+/)||[''])[0];return'.'+d.padEnd(9,'0')+'Z'})};

class FbErr extends Error{constructor(m,status){super(m);this.status=status}}
async function signIn(email,password){
  const r=await fetch(`${EP.idt}/accounts:signInWithPassword?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey())}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email,password,returnSecureToken:true})});
  const j=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
  if(!r.ok){const m=(j.error&&j.error.message)||'';throw new FbErr(/INVALID|PASSWORD|EMAIL_NOT_FOUND|CREDENTIAL/.test(m)?'Email o contraseña incorrectos.':/API key|API_KEY/i.test(m)?'La apiKey no es válida. Revisá que sea la del proyecto del Apiario.':'No se pudo ingresar: '+m,r.status)}
  auth={idToken:j.idToken,refreshToken:j.refreshToken,exp:Date.now()+(+j.expiresIn||3600)*1000,email:j.email,uid:j.localId};LS.set('percha_auth',auth);
}
async function refresh(){
  const r=await fetch(`${EP.sec}/token?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey())}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},body:'grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token='+encodeURIComponent(auth.refreshToken)});
  const j=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
  if(!r.ok){if(r.status===400){logout('Tu sesión venció. Ingresá de nuevo.')}throw new FbErr('No se pudo renovar la sesión',r.status)}
  auth.idToken=j.id_token;auth.refreshToken=j.refresh_token;auth.exp=Date.now()+(+j.expires_in||3600)*1000;LS.set('percha_auth',auth);
}
async function fsReq(method,suffix,body,retry=true){
  if(!auth)throw new FbErr('Sin sesión',401);
  if(Date.now()>auth.exp-60000)await refresh();
  const ac=new AbortController();const to=setTimeout(()=>ac.abort(),15000);
  let r;try{r=await fetch(fsUrl(suffix),{method,signal:ac.signal,headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+auth.idToken,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:body?JSON.stringify(body):undefined})}finally{clearTimeout(to)}
  if(r.status===401&&retry){await refresh();return fsReq(method,suffix,body,false)}
  if(r.status===404&&method==='GET')return null;
  const j=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
  if(!r.ok)throw new FbErr((j.error&&j.error.message)||('Error '+r.status),r.status);
  return j;
}

/* ============ datos locales (copia de lo que hay en la nube) ============ */
let db,outbox=[],cfg;
const emptyDb=()=>({items:[],ventas:[],movs:[],gastos:[],cola:[],tienda:'',metaUpd:'',since:{items:'',ventas:'',movs:'',gastos:'',cola:''}});
const cacheKey=()=>'percha_cache_'+(auth?auth.uid:'x');
const outKey=()=>'percha_outbox_'+(auth?auth.uid:'x');
function loadLocal(){db=Object.assign(emptyDb(),LS.get(cacheKey(),{}));outbox=LS.get(outKey(),[]);
  cfg=Object.assign({modo:'a4',hoja:'65',start:1,rolloW:40,rolloH:25,info:true,precio:false,custom:{cols:4,rows:10,w:40,h:25,top:10,left:10,hp:45,vp:27}},LS.get('percha_cfg2',{}));}
function saveLocal(){LS.set(cacheKey(),db);LS.set(outKey(),outbox)}
const saveCfg=()=>LS.set('percha_cfg2',cfg);
const strip=o=>{const{id,upd,...r}=o;return r};

/* escritura: se encola, se aplica en pantalla al instante y se sube en segundo plano */
function w(key,id,fields={},opt={}){
  const tr=Object.entries(opt.inc||{}).map(([f,n])=>({fieldPath:f,increment:{integerValue:String(Math.round(n))}}));
  tr.push({fieldPath:'upd',setToServerValue:'REQUEST_TIME'});
  const wr={update:{name:docPath(key==='meta'?META:COLS[key]+'/'+id),fields:encF(fields)},updateTransforms:tr};
  if(!opt.full)wr.updateMask={fieldPaths:Object.keys(fields)};
  outbox.push(wr);
}
function commit(){saveLocal();renderSync();clearTimeout(commit.t);commit.t=setTimeout(()=>sync(),300)}
async function reserve(field,n){
  const j=await fsReq('POST',':commit',{writes:[{update:{name:docPath(META),fields:{}},updateMask:{fieldPaths:[]},updateTransforms:[{fieldPath:field,increment:{integerValue:String(n)}},{fieldPath:'upd',setToServerValue:'REQUEST_TIME'}]}]});
  return Number(j.writeResults[0].transformResults[0].integerValue);
}
let syncing=false,net='',netMsg='',lastSync=null,again=false;
async function flush(){
  while(outbox.length){
    const b=outbox.slice(0,450);
    const touch={update:{name:docPath(META),fields:{}},updateMask:{fieldPaths:[]},updateTransforms:[{fieldPath:'upd',setToServerValue:'REQUEST_TIME'}]};
    try{await fsReq('POST',':commit',{writes:b.concat([touch])})}
    catch(e){if(e.status===400){outbox.splice(0,b.length);saveLocal();toast('Firebase rechazó un cambio: '+e.message,true);continue}throw e}
    outbox.splice(0,b.length);saveLocal();
  }
}
async function pullCol(key){
  const sq={from:[{collectionId:COLS[key]}]};const since=db.since[key];
  if(since)sq.where={fieldFilter:{field:{fieldPath:'upd'},op:'GREATER_THAN',value:{timestampValue:since}}};
  const res=await fsReq('POST',':runQuery',{structuredQuery:sq});
  const pend=new Set(outbox.map(x=>x.update.name.split('/').pop()));
  let ch=false;const arr=db[key];
  for(const r of res||[]){
    if(!r.document)continue;
    const id=r.document.name.split('/').pop();const o=decF(r.document.fields||{});o.id=id;
    if(o.upd&&tsNorm(o.upd)>tsNorm(db.since[key]))db.since[key]=tsNorm(o.upd);
    if(pend.has(id))continue;
    const i=arr.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);
    const dead=o.borrado||(key==='cola'&&!(o.cant>0));
    if(dead){if(i>=0){arr.splice(i,1);ch=true}continue}
    if(i>=0){if(JSON.stringify(arr[i])!==JSON.stringify(o)){arr[i]=o;ch=true}}else{arr.push(o);ch=true}
  }
  return ch;
}
async function sync(full){
  if(!auth)return;if(syncing){again=true;return}
  syncing=true;let ch=false;
  try{
    await flush();
    const m=await fsReq('GET','/'+META);const meta=m?decF(m.fields||{}):{};
    if(full||meta.upd!==db.metaUpd||!lastSync){for(const k of Object.keys(COLS))ch=(await pullCol(k))||ch;db.metaUpd=meta.upd||''}
    if((meta.tienda||'')!==db.tienda){db.tienda=meta.tienda||'';ch=true}
    net='ok';netMsg='';lastSync=new Date();saveLocal();
  }catch(e){
    if(e instanceof FbErr){net=e.status===403?'err':'off';netMsg=e.status===403?'Firebase no da permiso. Revisá las reglas de Firestore (ver Ajustes).':e.message}
    else{net='off';netMsg='Sin conexión. Los cambios se guardan y se suben solos cuando vuelva internet.'}
  }finally{syncing=false;renderSync();if(ch)onRemote();if(again){again=false;setTimeout(sync,50)}}
  return ch;
}
/* para no pisar lo que el usuario está escribiendo, solo se redibujan las vistas de consulta */
function onRemote(){
  if(!auth)return;renderChrome();
  if(!$('#modal').hidden)return;
  if(['ventas','informes','patrimonio'].includes(view))render();
  else if(view==='stock')renderStock();
  else if(view==='vender'){cart=cart.filter(l=>itemById(l.itemId));renderCart()}
  else if(view==='etiquetas'&&!document.activeElement.closest('#main'))render();
}
function logout(msg){
  if(auth){LS.del('percha_auth')}auth=null;cart=[];db=emptyDb();outbox=[];
  render();if(msg)toast(msg,true);
}

/* ============ operaciones del negocio ============ */
const itemById=id=>db.items.find(i=>i.id===id);
const tiendaNombre=()=>db.tienda||'Camelias Kids';
const itemByCode=c=>{c=String(c).trim();return db.items.find(i=>i.code===c)};
const fullName=it=>it.nombre+(it.color?' · '+it.color:'');
async function reserveCodes(n){
  if(!n)return[];
  const end=await reserve('seq',n);const out=[];
  for(let k=end-n+1;k<=end;k++){const c=String(10000000+k);if(!itemByCode(c))out.push(c)}
  while(out.length<n){const e=await reserve('seq',1);const c=String(10000000+e);if(!itemByCode(c))out.push(c)}
  return out;
}
function newItem(o){
  const it={id:'i'+uid(),code:o.code,nombre:o.nombre,categoria:o.categoria||'',marca:o.marca||'',proveedor:o.proveedor||'',talle:o.talle||'',color:o.color||'',costo:+o.costo||0,precio:+o.precio||0,stock:0,creado:new Date().toISOString()};
  db.items.push(it);w('items',it.id,strip(it),{full:true});
  if(o.cant>0)ingreso(it,o.cant,it.costo);
  return it;
}
function ingreso(it,cant,costo){
  cant=+cant;costo=+costo;
  if(it.stock>0&&costo!==it.costo)it.costo=Math.round((it.stock*it.costo+cant*costo)/(it.stock+cant));else it.costo=costo;
  it.stock+=cant;w('items',it.id,{costo:it.costo},{inc:{stock:cant}});
  addMov({itemId:it.id,tipo:'ingreso',cant,costo});
}
function addMov(m){m.id=uid();m.fecha=m.fecha||new Date().toISOString();db.movs.push(m);w('movs',m.id,strip(m),{full:true})}
function queueLabels(it,n){if(n<=0)return;const q=db.cola.find(c=>c.itemId===it.id);
  if(q)q.cant+=n;else db.cola.push({id:it.id,itemId:it.id,cant:n});
  w('cola',it.id,{itemId:it.id,borrado:false},{inc:{cant:n}})}
function setLabel(id,n){const q=db.cola.find(c=>c.itemId===id);n=Math.max(0,Math.round(n));
  if(n){if(q)q.cant=n}else db.cola=db.cola.filter(c=>c.itemId!==id);
  w('cola',id,{itemId:id,cant:n,borrado:!n})}
async function registrarVenta(lines,desc,descTipo,pago){
  let nro;try{nro=await reserve('ventaSeq',1)}catch(e){nro='SC-'+uid().slice(-4).toUpperCase()}
  const items=lines.map(l=>{const it=itemById(l.itemId);return{itemId:it.id,code:it.code,nombre:it.nombre,talle:it.talle,color:it.color,cant:l.cant,precio:l.precio,costo:it.costo}});
  const subtotal=items.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.cant*l.precio,0);
  const descMonto=descTipo==='%'?Math.round(subtotal*Math.min(100,desc||0)/100):Math.min(subtotal,+desc||0);
  const v={id:'v'+uid(),nro,fecha:new Date().toISOString(),items,subtotal,desc:descMonto,total:subtotal-descMonto,pago,anulada:false,usuario:auth?auth.email:''};
  db.ventas.push(v);w('ventas',v.id,strip(v),{full:true});
  items.forEach(l=>{const it=itemById(l.itemId);it.stock-=l.cant;w('items',it.id,{},{inc:{stock:-l.cant}});addMov({itemId:it.id,tipo:'venta',cant:-l.cant,costo:l.costo,ventaId:v.id})});
  commit();return v;
}
const cmv=v=>v.items.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.cant*l.costo,0);
const ventasEn=(a,b)=>db.ventas.filter(v=>!v.anulada&&new Date(v.fecha)>=a&&new Date(v.fecha)<b);

/* ============ períodos ============ */
const per={ventas:{p:'mes'},informes:{p:'mes'},gastos:{p:'mes'}};
const PER=[['hoy','Hoy'],['7d','7 días'],['mes','Este mes'],['mesant','Mes anterior'],['anio','Este año'],['todo','Todo'],['rango','Elegir fechas']];
function rangeOf(st){
  const t=new Date();t.setHours(0,0,0,0);const tm=new Date(t);tm.setDate(t.getDate()+1);
  switch(st.p){
    case 'hoy':return[t,tm];
    case '7d':{const a=new Date(t);a.setDate(t.getDate()-6);return[a,tm]}
    case 'mes':return[new Date(t.getFullYear(),t.getMonth(),1),new Date(t.getFullYear(),t.getMonth()+1,1)];
    case 'mesant':return[new Date(t.getFullYear(),t.getMonth()-1,1),new Date(t.getFullYear(),t.getMonth(),1)];
    case 'anio':return[new Date(t.getFullYear(),0,1),new Date(t.getFullYear()+1,0,1)];
    case 'rango':{const a=st.d?new Date(st.d+'T00:00'):new Date(2000,0,1);const b=st.h?new Date(st.h+'T00:00'):new Date(t);b.setDate(b.getDate()+1);return[a,b]}
    default:{let a=new Date(t);db.ventas.concat(db.gastos).forEach(x=>{const d=new Date(x.fecha);if(d<a)a=d});a.setHours(0,0,0,0);return[a,tm]}
  }
}
function perBar(v){const st=per[v];
  return `<div class="row"><div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Período">${PER.map(([k,l])=>`<button data-act="per" data-v="${v}" data-p="${k}" aria-pressed="${st.p===k}">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div>
  ${st.p==='rango'?`<label class="f">Desde<input type="date" id="pd-${v}" value="${st.d||''}" data-per-date="${v}" data-k="d"></label><label class="f">Hasta<input type="date" id="ph-${v}" value="${st.h||''}" data-per-date="${v}" data-k="h"></label>`:''}</div>`}

/* ============ UI base ============ */
const TABS=[['vender','Vender'],['ingresar','Ingresar mercadería'],['stock','Stock'],['etiquetas','Etiquetas'],['ventas','Ventas'],['informes','Ingresos'],['patrimonio','Patrimonio'],['gastos','Gastos'],['datos','Ajustes']];
let view='vender';
function go(v){if(!TABS.find(t=>t[0]===v))v='vender';view=v;if(location.hash!=='#'+v)history.replaceState(null,'','#'+v);render();window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function renderSync(){
  const s=$('#syncSt');if(!s)return;const p=outbox.length;
  s.className='sync '+(net||'');
  s.innerHTML=`<i></i>${net==='ok'?(p?'Subiendo '+p+' cambio'+(p>1?'s':''):'Sincronizado'):net==='off'?'Sin conexión'+(p?' · '+p+' pendiente'+(p>1?'s':''):''):net==='err'?'Error de permisos':'Conectando…'}`;
  s.title=netMsg||(lastSync?'Última sincronización '+lastSync.toLocaleTimeString('es-AR'):'');
}
function renderChrome(){
  $('#shopName').textContent='';
  if(!auth){$('#tabs').innerHTML='';$('#todayStrip').innerHTML='';return}
  const n=db.cola.reduce((a,c)=>a+c.cant,0);
  $('#tabs').innerHTML=TABS.map(([k,l])=>`<button class="tab" data-act="tab" data-t="${k}" ${view===k?'aria-current="page"':''}>${l}${k==='etiquetas'&&n?` <span class="badge">${n}</span>`:''}</button>`).join('');
  const t=new Date();t.setHours(0,0,0,0);const tm=new Date(t);tm.setDate(t.getDate()+1);const vs=ventasEn(t,tm);
  $('#todayStrip').innerHTML=`<span>Hoy <b>${money(vs.reduce((a,v)=>a+v.total,0))}</b></span><span><b>${vs.length}</b> ventas</span><button class="sync" id="syncSt" data-act="sync-now"></button>`;
  renderSync();
}
function render(){renderChrome();const m=$('#main');
  if(!auth){m.innerHTML=V.login();AFTER.login();return}
  m.innerHTML=`<section class="view">${(V[view]||V.vender)()}</section>`;(AFTER[view]||(()=>{}))();}
let toastT;
function toast(msg,err){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=msg;t.className=err?'err':'';t.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastT);toastT=setTimeout(()=>t.hidden=true,err?4500:2600)}
function modal(html,mount){$('#modalCard').innerHTML=html;$('#modal').hidden=false;mount&&mount($('#modalCard'));const f=$('#modalCard input,#modalCard select');f&&f.focus()}
function closeModal(){camStop();$('#modal').hidden=true;$('#modalCard').innerHTML=''}
function confirmBox(title,msg,ok,cb,danger=true){
  modal(`<h3>${esc(title)}</h3><p class="muted" style="margin:0">${msg}</p><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn" data-act="modal-close">Cancelar</button><button class="btn ${danger?'danger':'pri'}" id="cbOk">${esc(ok)}</button></div>`,c=>{$('#cbOk',c).onclick=()=>{closeModal();cb()}});
}
function download(name,text,type){const b=new Blob([text],{type});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b);a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove()},500)}
const V={},AFTER={},ACT={};
const searchItems=(q,limit=8)=>{q=q.trim().toLowerCase();if(!q)return[];const ws=q.split(/\s+/);
  return db.items.filter(i=>{const h=(i.code+' '+i.nombre+' '+i.talle+' '+i.color+' '+i.marca+' '+i.categoria).toLowerCase();return ws.every(w=>h.includes(w))}).slice(0,limit)};
const resBtn=(it,act)=>`<button class="res" data-act="${act}" data-id="${it.id}"><span><span class="item-name">${esc(fullName(it))}</span> <span class="item-sub">Talle ${esc(it.talle||'—')} · <span class="mono">${esc(it.code)}</span></span></span><span class="mono">${money(it.precio)} <span class="pill ${it.stock>0?'neu':'bad'}">${it.stock} u.</span></span></button>`;
const CAM_ICON='<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.5"/></svg>';
const camBtn=(target,label)=>navigator.mediaDevices?`<button type="button" class="btn cam" data-act="cam" data-target="${target}" aria-label="Escanear con la cámara" title="Escanear con la cámara">${CAM_ICON}${label?' '+label:''}</button>`:'';

/* ============ LOGIN ============ */
V.login=()=>`<form class="panel login" id="fLogin" autocomplete="on">
  <div class="login-logo"><img src="${LOGO}" alt="Camelias Kids"></div>
  <h2>Ingresar a la tienda</h2>
  <p class="muted" style="margin:0">Usá la misma cuenta de Firebase que el Apiario. En cada computadora o celular se ingresa una sola vez.</p>
  ${apiKey()?'':`<label class="f">apiKey de Firebase<input id="lk" class="mono" placeholder="AIza…" autocomplete="off"></label><span class="hint">Está en el código del Apiario, en la línea <span class="mono">apiKey</span>. Mejor todavía: pegala arriba de todo en este archivo antes de subirlo a GitHub y no la vas a tener que poner en cada equipo.</span>`}
  <label class="f">Email<input type="email" id="le" autocomplete="username" required></label>
  <label class="f">Contraseña<input type="password" id="lp" autocomplete="current-password" required></label>
  <div class="err" id="lerr"></div>
  <button class="btn pri cobrar" type="submit" id="lbtn">Ingresar</button>
</form>`;
AFTER.login=()=>{$('#fLogin').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const k=$('#lk');if(k){if(!k.value.trim()){$('#lerr').textContent='Falta la apiKey.';return}LS.set('percha_apikey',k.value.trim())}
  const b=$('#lbtn');b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Ingresando…';$('#lerr').textContent='';
  try{await signIn($('#le').value.trim(),$('#lp').value);loadLocal();$('#main').innerHTML='<div class="empty">Descargando los datos de la tienda…</div>';await sync(true);render()}
  catch(err){$('#lerr').textContent=err instanceof FbErr?err.message:'No hay conexión con Firebase. Revisá internet.';b.disabled=false;b.textContent='Ingresar'}}};

/* ============ VENDER ============ */
let cart=[],cartDesc=0,cartDescT='%',cartPago='Efectivo',lastSale=null,cobrando=false;
V.vender=()=>`
<div class="pos">
  <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0">
    <div class="scanbox"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 7V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2M17 3h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2M21 17v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-2M7 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2M7 8v8M10 8v8M13 8v8M17 8v8"/></svg>
      <input id="scan" placeholder="Escaneá la etiqueta o buscá por nombre" autocomplete="off" inputmode="search" aria-label="Código o búsqueda">${camBtn('scan')}</div>
    <div class="results" id="scanRes"></div>
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Prenda</th><th>Talle</th><th class="r">Precio</th><th>Cant.</th><th class="r">Importe</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="cartBody"></tbody></table></div>
  </div>
  <aside class="panel till">
    <h3>Cobro</h3>
    <div class="line"><span class="muted">Subtotal</span><span class="num" id="tSub"></span></div>
    <div class="line"><span class="muted">Descuento</span><span style="display:flex;gap:6px;width:170px"><input type="number" min="0" id="desc" value="${cartDesc||''}" placeholder="0"><select id="descT" style="width:72px;flex:none"><option ${cartDescT==='%'?'selected':''}>%</option><option ${cartDescT==='$'?'selected':''}>$</option></select></span></div>
    <div class="total"><span class="muted">Total</span><b id="tTot"></b></div>
    <label class="f">Medio de pago<select id="pago">${PAGOS.map(p=>`<option ${p===cartPago?'selected':''}>${p}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
    <div id="efect" class="line"><label class="f" style="flex:1">Paga con<input type="number" min="0" id="pagaCon" placeholder="0"></label><div style="text-align:right"><div class="muted" style="font-size:.78rem">VUELTO</div><b class="num" id="vuelto">—</b></div></div>
    <button class="btn pri cobrar" data-act="cobrar" id="btnCobrar">Cobrar</button>
    <button class="btn ghost sm" data-act="cart-clear">Vaciar carrito</button>
    <div id="lastSale"></div>
  </aside>
</div>`;
AFTER.vender=()=>{
  const s=$('#scan');if(matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches)s.focus();
  s.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();scanSubmit(s.value)}});
  s.addEventListener('input',()=>{const q=s.value;if(!q.trim()){$('#scanRes').innerHTML='';return}if(/^\d{6,}$/.test(q.trim()))return;
    $('#scanRes').innerHTML=searchItems(q).map(it=>resBtn(it,'cart-add')).join('')});
  ['desc','descT','pago','pagaCon'].forEach(id=>$('#'+id).addEventListener('input',()=>{cartDesc=numIn($('#desc').value);cartDescT=$('#descT').value;cartPago=$('#pago').value;renderCart()}));
  renderCart();
};
function scanSubmit(v){
  v=String(v).trim();if(!v)return null;const s=$('#scan');
  const it=itemByCode(v);
  if(it){const ok=addToCart(it);if(s){s.value='';$('#scanRes').innerHTML=''}return ok?it:null}
  const r=searchItems(v);
  if(r.length===1){const ok=addToCart(r[0]);if(s){s.value='';$('#scanRes').innerHTML=''}return ok?r[0]:null}
  if(!r.length){toast('No encontré ninguna prenda con "'+v+'"',true);s&&s.select();return null}
  $('#scanRes').innerHTML=r.map(it=>resBtn(it,'cart-add')).join('');return null;
}
function addToCart(it){
  const l=cart.find(c=>c.itemId===it.id);const enCarrito=l?l.cant:0;
  if(it.stock-enCarrito<=0){toast('Sin stock de '+fullName(it)+' talle '+(it.talle||'—')+'. Revisá el stock o hacé un ajuste.',true);return false}
  if(l)l.cant++;else cart.push({itemId:it.id,cant:1,precio:it.precio});
  lastSale=null;renderCart();toast('+ '+it.nombre+' '+(it.talle||''));return true;
}
function cartTotals(){const sub=cart.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.cant*l.precio,0);const d=cartDescT==='%'?Math.round(sub*Math.min(100,cartDesc)/100):Math.min(sub,cartDesc);return{sub,d,tot:sub-d}}
function renderCart(){
  const b=$('#cartBody');if(!b)return;
  b.innerHTML=cart.length?cart.map(l=>{const it=itemById(l.itemId);return`<tr><td><div class="item-name">${esc(fullName(it))}</div><div class="item-sub mono">${esc(it.code)}</div></td><td>${esc(it.talle||'—')}</td><td class="r num">${money(l.precio)}</td>
    <td><span class="qty"><button data-act="cart-dec" data-id="${it.id}" aria-label="Restar">−</button><span>${l.cant}</span><button data-act="cart-inc" data-id="${it.id}" aria-label="Sumar">+</button></span></td>
    <td class="r num">${money(l.cant*l.precio)}</td><td><button class="btn sm ghost danger" data-act="cart-del" data-id="${it.id}" aria-label="Quitar">✕</button></td></tr>`}).join('')
   :`<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Escaneá una etiqueta para empezar la venta.<br><span class="hint">Con lector USB o con la cámara del celular (botón al lado del buscador).</span></td></tr>`;
  const t=cartTotals();$('#tSub').textContent=money(t.sub);$('#tTot').textContent=money(t.tot);
  $('#efect').hidden=$('#pago').value!=='Efectivo';
  const pc=numIn($('#pagaCon').value);$('#vuelto').textContent=pc?money(pc-t.tot):'—';
  $('#btnCobrar').disabled=!cart.length||cobrando;$('#btnCobrar').textContent=cobrando?'Registrando…':cart.length?'Cobrar '+money(t.tot):'Cobrar';
  $('#lastSale').innerHTML=lastSale?`<div class="sold"><b>Venta #${esc(lastSale.nro)} registrada</b><br>${money(lastSale.total)} · ${esc(lastSale.pago)} · ${lastSale.items.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.cant,0)} prenda(s). El stock ya se descontó.</div>`:'';
}
ACT['cart-add']=b=>{addToCart(itemById(b.dataset.id));$('#scan').value='';$('#scanRes').innerHTML=''};
ACT['cart-inc']=b=>{const it=itemById(b.dataset.id);const l=cart.find(c=>c.itemId===it.id);if(l.cant>=it.stock){toast('No hay más stock de esa prenda',true);return}l.cant++;renderCart()};
ACT['cart-dec']=b=>{const l=cart.find(c=>c.itemId===b.dataset.id);l.cant--;if(l.cant<=0)cart=cart.filter(c=>c!==l);renderCart()};
ACT['cart-del']=b=>{cart=cart.filter(c=>c.itemId!==b.dataset.id);renderCart()};
ACT['cart-clear']=()=>{cart=[];cartDesc=0;$('#desc').value='';$('#pagaCon').value='';renderCart()};
ACT['cobrar']=async()=>{if(!cart.length||cobrando)return;cobrando=true;renderCart();
  try{lastSale=await registrarVenta(cart,cartDesc,cartDescT,$('#pago').value);
    cart=[];cartDesc=0;toast(typeof lastSale.nro==='string'?'Venta guardada sin internet. Se sube sola cuando vuelva la conexión.':'Venta registrada: '+money(lastSale.total),typeof lastSale.nro==='string');}
  finally{cobrando=false;if(view==='vender'){$('#desc').value='';$('#pagaCon').value='';renderChrome();renderCart()}}};

/* ============ INGRESAR ============ */
let ingMode='nueva',vars=[{talle:'',color:'',cant:1,code:''}],repItem=null,lastIngreso=null,guardando=false;
const catsList=()=>[...new Set([...CATS,...db.items.map(i=>i.categoria).filter(Boolean)])].sort();
const dl=(id,arr)=>`<datalist id="${id}">${arr.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join('')}</datalist>`;
V.ingresar=()=>`
<div class="vhead"><div><h2>Ingresar mercadería</h2><p>Cargá cada prenda una vez con todos sus talles. Cada talle y color recibe su propio código de barras y va a la cola de etiquetas.</p></div>
<div class="seg"><button data-act="ing-mode" data-m="nueva" aria-pressed="${ingMode==='nueva'}">Prenda nueva</button><button data-act="ing-mode" data-m="repo" aria-pressed="${ingMode==='repo'}">Reponer una existente</button></div></div>
${lastIngreso?`<div class="sold"><b>${esc(lastIngreso)}</b> <button class="btn sm" data-act="tab" data-t="etiquetas" style="margin-left:8px">Ir a imprimir etiquetas</button></div>`:''}
${ingMode==='nueva'?ingNueva():ingRepo()}`;
function ingNueva(){return`
<form class="panel grid" id="fNueva" autocomplete="off" style="gap:16px">
  <div class="grid g2">
    <label class="f">Prenda *<input id="n-nombre" required placeholder="Ej: Remera oversize lino" list="dlNombres"></label>
    <label class="f">Categoría<input id="n-cat" list="dlCats" placeholder="Remeras"></label>
    <label class="f">Marca<input id="n-marca" list="dlMarcas"></label>
    <label class="f">Proveedor<input id="n-prov" list="dlProv"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="grid g4">
    <label class="f">Costo unitario<input type="number" min="0" step="1" id="n-costo" placeholder="0"></label>
    <label class="f">Recargo sobre costo %<input type="number" min="0" step="1" id="n-rec" value="100"></label>
    <label class="f">Precio de venta *<input type="number" min="0" step="1" id="n-precio" required placeholder="0"></label>
    <div class="f" style="justify-content:flex-end"><span class="hint" id="n-margen">Margen: —</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="grid" style="gap:8px">
    <div class="var-row var-head"><span>Talle</span><span>Color</span><span>Cantidad</span><span class="vc">Código de fábrica (opcional)</span><span></span></div>
    <div id="varRows" class="grid" style="gap:8px"></div>
    <div class="row"><button type="button" class="btn sm" data-act="var-add">+ Agregar talle / color</button><span class="hint">Si la prenda ya trae código de barras de fábrica, escanealo en esa columna y no hace falta etiqueta nueva.</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between">
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="n-lbl" checked> Mandar etiquetas a imprimir</label>
    <button class="btn pri" type="submit" id="n-save">Guardar ingreso</button>
  </div>
  ${dl('dlCats',catsList())}${dl('dlMarcas',[...new Set(db.items.map(i=>i.marca).filter(Boolean))])}${dl('dlProv',[...new Set(db.items.map(i=>i.proveedor).filter(Boolean))])}${dl('dlNombres',[...new Set(db.items.map(i=>i.nombre))])}
</form>`}
function renderVars(){
  $('#varRows').innerHTML=vars.map((v,i)=>`<div class="var-row">
    <input data-var="${i}" data-k="talle" value="${esc(v.talle)}" placeholder="M" aria-label="Talle">
    <input data-var="${i}" data-k="color" value="${esc(v.color)}" placeholder="Negro" aria-label="Color">
    <input data-var="${i}" data-k="cant" type="number" min="0" value="${v.cant}" aria-label="Cantidad">
    <div class="vc inrow"><input class="mono" id="vcode-${i}" data-var="${i}" data-k="code" value="${esc(v.code)}" placeholder="automático" aria-label="Código de fábrica">${camBtn('var-'+i)}</div>
    <button type="button" class="btn sm ghost danger" data-act="var-del" data-i="${i}" ${vars.length<2?'disabled':''} aria-label="Quitar fila">✕</button></div>`).join('');
}
AFTER.ingresar=()=>{
  if(ingMode==='nueva'){
    renderVars();
    $('#varRows').addEventListener('input',e=>{const t=e.target;if(t.dataset.var==null)return;vars[+t.dataset.var][t.dataset.k]=t.dataset.k==='cant'?numIn(t.value):t.value});
    $('#varRows').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&e.target.dataset.k==='code')e.preventDefault()});
    const c=$('#n-costo'),r=$('#n-rec'),p=$('#n-precio');
    const marg=()=>{const co=numIn(c.value),pr=numIn(p.value);$('#n-margen').textContent=pr?'Margen sobre venta: '+pct((pr-co)/pr)+' · Ganás '+money(pr-co)+' por prenda':'Margen: —'};
    c.oninput=r.oninput=()=>{const co=numIn(c.value);if(co)p.value=Math.round(co*(1+numIn(r.value)/100)/100)*100;marg()};
    p.oninput=()=>{const co=numIn(c.value),pr=numIn(p.value);if(co)r.value=Math.round((pr/co-1)*100);marg()};
    $('#n-nombre').addEventListener('change',e=>{const ex=db.items.find(i=>i.nombre.toLowerCase()===e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase());if(ex){$('#n-cat').value=ex.categoria;$('#n-marca').value=ex.marca;$('#n-prov').value=ex.proveedor;c.value=ex.costo;p.value=ex.precio;marg()}});
    $('#fNueva').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();guardarNueva()};
  }else AFTER_repo();
};
ACT['ing-mode']=b=>{ingMode=b.dataset.m;lastIngreso=null;render()};
ACT['var-add']=()=>{const l=vars[vars.length-1];vars.push({talle:'',color:l?l.color:'',cant:1,code:''});renderVars();$$('#varRows [data-k=talle]').pop().focus()};
ACT['var-del']=b=>{vars.splice(+b.dataset.i,1);renderVars()};
async function guardarNueva(){
  if(guardando)return;
  const nombre=$('#n-nombre').value.trim(),precio=numIn($('#n-precio').value),costo=numIn($('#n-costo').value);
  if(!nombre){toast('Poné el nombre de la prenda',true);return}
  if(!precio){toast('Falta el precio de venta',true);$('#n-precio').focus();return}
  const rows=vars.filter(v=>v.cant>0||v.talle||v.code).map(v=>({...v,code:String(v.code||'').trim(),talle:String(v.talle).trim(),color:String(v.color).trim()}));
  if(!rows.length){toast('Agregá al menos un talle con cantidad',true);return}
  for(const v of rows){if(v.code&&itemByCode(v.code)){toast('El código '+v.code+' ya existe en otra prenda',true);return}}
  const own=rows.map(v=>v.code).filter(Boolean);if(new Set(own).size!==own.length){toast('Hay códigos repetidos en las filas',true);return}
  const lo=s=>String(s).toLowerCase();
  const dupOf=v=>!v.code&&db.items.find(i=>lo(i.nombre)===lo(nombre)&&lo(i.talle)===lo(v.talle)&&lo(i.color)===lo(v.color));
  const need=rows.filter(v=>!v.code&&!dupOf(v)).length;
  guardando=true;const btn=$('#n-save');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Guardando…';
  let codes;
  try{codes=await reserveCodes(need)}
  catch(e){guardando=false;btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Guardar ingreso';toast('Para dar de alta prendas nuevas hace falta internet (así dos equipos nunca generan el mismo código).',true);return}
  const lbl=$('#n-lbl').checked;let u=0,n=0;
  const base={nombre,categoria:$('#n-cat').value.trim(),marca:$('#n-marca').value.trim(),proveedor:$('#n-prov').value.trim(),costo,precio};
  rows.forEach(v=>{
    const dup=dupOf(v);let it;
    if(dup){ingreso(dup,v.cant,costo||dup.costo);if(dup.precio!==precio){dup.precio=precio;w('items',dup.id,{precio})}it=dup}
    else{it=newItem({...base,talle:v.talle,color:v.color,cant:v.cant,code:v.code||codes.shift()});n++}
    if(lbl&&!v.code)queueLabels(it,v.cant);u+=v.cant;
  });
  commit();guardando=false;vars=[{talle:'',color:'',cant:1,code:''}];
  lastIngreso=`Ingresaste ${u} prenda(s) de ${nombre}${n?` (${n} artículo${n>1?'s':''} nuevo${n>1?'s':''})`:''}.`;render();
}
function ingRepo(){return`
<div class="panel grid" style="gap:14px">
  <label class="f">Buscá o escaneá la prenda<span class="inrow"><input id="r-q" placeholder="Código, nombre, talle…" autocomplete="off">${camBtn('r-q')}</span></label>
  <div class="results" id="r-res"></div>
  ${repItem?`<form id="fRepo" class="grid" style="gap:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px">
    <div><span class="item-name">${esc(fullName(repItem))}</span> <span class="item-sub">Talle ${esc(repItem.talle||'—')} · <span class="mono">${esc(repItem.code)}</span> · Hay ${repItem.stock} u. · Costo actual ${money(repItem.costo)}</span></div>
    <div class="grid g4">
      <label class="f">Cantidad que entra<input type="number" min="1" id="r-cant" value="1"></label>
      <label class="f">Costo unitario de esta compra<input type="number" min="0" id="r-costo" value="${repItem.costo}"></label>
      <label class="f">Precio de venta<input type="number" min="0" id="r-precio" value="${repItem.precio}"></label>
    </div>
    <span class="hint">Si el costo cambió, el costo de la prenda pasa a ser el promedio ponderado entre lo que había y lo que entra.</span>
    <div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between"><label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="r-lbl" checked> Mandar etiquetas a imprimir</label><button class="btn pri" type="submit">Sumar al stock</button></div>
  </form>`:''}
</div>`}
function AFTER_repo(){
  const q=$('#r-q');
  const show=()=>{$('#r-res').innerHTML=searchItems(q.value).map(it=>resBtn(it,'rep-pick')).join('')};
  q.oninput=show;q.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();const it=itemByCode(q.value);if(it){repItem=it;render()}else show()}};
  if(repItem){$('#r-cant').focus();$('#r-cant').select();$('#fRepo').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();
    const c=numIn($('#r-cant').value);if(c<=0){toast('La cantidad tiene que ser mayor a 0',true);return}
    ingreso(repItem,c,numIn($('#r-costo').value));const np=numIn($('#r-precio').value);if(np&&np!==repItem.precio){repItem.precio=np;w('items',repItem.id,{precio:np})}
    if($('#r-lbl').checked)queueLabels(repItem,c);commit();lastIngreso=`Sumaste ${c} u. a ${fullName(repItem)} talle ${repItem.talle||'—'}. Ahora hay ${repItem.stock}.`;repItem=null;render()}}
}
ACT['rep-pick']=b=>{repItem=itemById(b.dataset.id);render()};

/* ============ STOCK ============ */
let stkQ='',stkCat='',stkFil='todos';
V.stock=()=>{const tot=db.items.reduce((a,i)=>a+Math.max(0,i.stock),0);
  return`<div class="vhead"><div><h2>Stock</h2><p>${db.items.length} artículos · <span class="num">${tot}</span> prendas en el local.</p></div>
  <button class="btn pri" data-act="tab" data-t="ingresar">+ Ingresar mercadería</button></div>
  <div class="row">
    <label class="f grow">Buscar o escanear<span class="inrow"><input id="stkQ" value="${esc(stkQ)}" placeholder="Código, prenda, talle, color, marca…" autocomplete="off">${camBtn('stkQ')}</span></label>
    <label class="f">Categoría<select id="stkCat"><option value="">Todas</option>${[...new Set(db.items.map(i=>i.categoria).filter(Boolean))].sort().map(c=>`<option ${c===stkCat?'selected':''}>${esc(c)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
    <div class="seg"><button data-act="stk-fil" data-f="todos" aria-pressed="${stkFil==='todos'}">Todos</button><button data-act="stk-fil" data-f="bajo" aria-pressed="${stkFil==='bajo'}">Quedan pocas</button><button data-act="stk-fil" data-f="sin" aria-pressed="${stkFil==='sin'}">Sin stock</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Código</th><th>Prenda</th><th>Talle</th><th class="r">Stock</th><th class="r">Costo</th><th class="r">Precio</th><th class="r">Margen</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="stkBody"></tbody></table></div>`};
function renderStock(){
  const b=$('#stkBody');if(!b)return;
  let l=stkQ.trim()?searchItems(stkQ,10000):db.items.slice();
  if(stkCat)l=l.filter(i=>i.categoria===stkCat);
  if(stkFil==='bajo')l=l.filter(i=>i.stock>0&&i.stock<=2);if(stkFil==='sin')l=l.filter(i=>i.stock<=0);
  l.sort((a,b)=>a.nombre.localeCompare(b.nombre)||String(a.color).localeCompare(b.color)||sizeOrd(a.talle)-sizeOrd(b.talle));
  b.innerHTML=l.length?l.map(i=>`<tr>
    <td class="mono">${esc(i.code)}</td>
    <td><div class="item-name">${esc(fullName(i))}</div><div class="item-sub">${esc([i.categoria,i.marca].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</div></td>
    <td>${esc(i.talle||'—')}</td>
    <td class="r"><span class="pill ${i.stock<=0?'bad':i.stock<=2?'warn':'good'}">${i.stock}</span></td>
    <td class="r num">${money(i.costo)}</td><td class="r num">${money(i.precio)}</td>
    <td class="r num">${i.precio?pct((i.precio-i.costo)/i.precio):'—'}</td>
    <td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn sm" data-act="stk-label" data-id="${i.id}">Etiqueta</button> <button class="btn sm" data-act="stk-adj" data-id="${i.id}">Ajustar</button> <button class="btn sm" data-act="stk-edit" data-id="${i.id}">Editar</button></td></tr>`).join('')
    :`<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty">${db.items.length?'Ninguna prenda coincide con el filtro.':'Todavía no hay mercadería cargada. Empezá en “Ingresar mercadería”.'}</td></tr>`;
}
AFTER.stock=()=>{const q=$('#stkQ');q.oninput=()=>{stkQ=q.value;renderStock()};q.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){const it=itemByCode(q.value);if(it)ACT['stk-edit']({dataset:{id:it.id}})}};
  $('#stkCat').onchange=e=>{stkCat=e.target.value;renderStock()};renderStock()};
ACT['stk-fil']=b=>{stkFil=b.dataset.f;render()};
ACT['stk-label']=b=>{const it=itemById(b.dataset.id);
  modal(`<h3>Etiquetas para ${esc(fullName(it))} · ${esc(it.talle||'—')}</h3><label class="f">Cantidad de etiquetas<input type="number" min="1" id="mq" value="${Math.max(1,it.stock)}"></label><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn" data-act="modal-close">Cancelar</button><button class="btn pri" id="mok">Agregar a la cola</button></div>`,
  c=>{$('#mok',c).onclick=()=>{queueLabels(it,Math.max(1,numIn($('#mq').value)));commit();closeModal();renderChrome();toast('Agregadas a la cola de etiquetas')}})};
ACT['stk-adj']=b=>{const it=itemById(b.dataset.id);
  modal(`<h3>Ajustar stock</h3><p class="muted" style="margin:0">${esc(fullName(it))} · talle ${esc(it.talle||'—')} · hoy hay <b>${it.stock}</b>. Usalo para corregir un conteo, fallas o pérdidas. Para mercadería que compraste usá “Ingresar mercadería”.</p>
  <div class="grid g2"><label class="f">Stock real contado<input type="number" min="0" id="aq" value="${it.stock}"></label><label class="f">Motivo<select id="am"><option>Corrección de conteo</option><option>Falla / rotura</option><option>Pérdida / faltante</option><option>Devolución a proveedor</option><option>Uso propio / regalo</option></select></label></div>
  <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn" data-act="modal-close">Cancelar</button><button class="btn pri" id="aok">Guardar ajuste</button></div>`,
  c=>{$('#aok',c).onclick=()=>{const n=Math.max(0,Math.round(numIn($('#aq').value)));const d=n-it.stock;if(!d){closeModal();return}
    addMov({itemId:it.id,tipo:'ajuste',cant:d,costo:it.costo,motivo:$('#am').value});it.stock=n;w('items',it.id,{},{inc:{stock:d}});commit();closeModal();renderStock();toast('Stock ajustado a '+n)}})};
ACT['stk-edit']=b=>{const it=itemById(b.dataset.id);const vend=db.movs.some(m=>m.itemId===it.id&&m.tipo==='venta');
  modal(`<h3>Editar prenda</h3><div class="grid g2">
   <label class="f">Prenda<input id="e-nombre" value="${esc(it.nombre)}"></label><label class="f">Categoría<input id="e-cat" value="${esc(it.categoria)}" list="dlC2"></label>
   <label class="f">Talle<input id="e-talle" value="${esc(it.talle)}"></label><label class="f">Color<input id="e-color" value="${esc(it.color)}"></label>
   <label class="f">Marca<input id="e-marca" value="${esc(it.marca)}"></label><label class="f">Proveedor<input id="e-prov" value="${esc(it.proveedor)}"></label>
   <label class="f">Costo<input type="number" id="e-costo" value="${it.costo}"></label><label class="f">Precio<input type="number" id="e-precio" value="${it.precio}"></label></div>
   <span class="hint">Código <span class="mono">${esc(it.code)}</span> · Stock ${it.stock}. Si cambiás el precio, reimprimí la etiqueta.</span>${dl('dlC2',catsList())}
   <div class="modal-actions">${vend?'':'<button class="btn danger" id="edel" style="margin-right:auto">Eliminar</button>'}<button class="btn" data-act="modal-close">Cancelar</button><button class="btn pri" id="eok">Guardar</button></div>`,
  c=>{$('#eok',c).onclick=()=>{const old=it.precio;const f={nombre:$('#e-nombre').value.trim()||it.nombre,categoria:$('#e-cat').value.trim(),talle:$('#e-talle').value.trim(),color:$('#e-color').value.trim(),marca:$('#e-marca').value.trim(),proveedor:$('#e-prov').value.trim(),costo:numIn($('#e-costo').value),precio:numIn($('#e-precio').value)};
      Object.assign(it,f);w('items',it.id,f);commit();closeModal();if(view==='stock')renderStock();toast(old!==it.precio?'Guardado. Cambió el precio: reimprimí la etiqueta.':'Guardado')};
     const d=$('#edel',c);if(d)d.onclick=()=>confirmBox('Eliminar prenda','Se borra '+esc(fullName(it))+' talle '+esc(it.talle||'—')+' y su historial de ingresos. No tiene ventas.','Eliminar',()=>{
       db.items=db.items.filter(x=>x!==it);w('items',it.id,{borrado:true});
       db.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId===it.id).forEach(m=>w('movs',m.id,{borrado:true}));db.movs=db.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId!==it.id);
       if(db.cola.find(q=>q.itemId===it.id))setLabel(it.id,0);commit();render();toast('Prenda eliminada')})})};

/* ============ ETIQUETAS ============ */
/* Hojas A4 autoadhesivas más comunes. top/left = margen hasta la primera etiqueta; hp/vp = distancia entre comienzos de etiquetas. */
const HOJAS={
  '65':{n:'65 por hoja · 38,1 × 21,2 mm',cols:5,rows:13,w:38.1,h:21.2,top:10.7,left:4.7,hp:40.6,vp:21.2},
  '44':{n:'44 por hoja · 48,5 × 25,4 mm',cols:4,rows:11,w:48.5,h:25.4,top:8.8,left:8,hp:48.5,vp:25.4},
  '40':{n:'40 por hoja · 45,7 × 25,4 mm',cols:4,rows:10,w:45.7,h:25.4,top:21.5,left:9.7,hp:48.3,vp:25.4},
  '24':{n:'24 por hoja · 70 × 37 mm',cols:3,rows:8,w:70,h:37,top:.5,left:0,hp:70,vp:37},
  'custom':{n:'Otra medida (la cargo yo)'}
};
const hoja=()=>cfg.hoja==='custom'?{...cfg.custom,n:'Otra medida'}:HOJAS[cfg.hoja]||HOJAS['65'];
const perSheet=()=>{const h=hoja();return h.cols*h.rows};
/* tamaño útil del sticker: nunca más de 40 × 40 mm */
function stickerBox(){if(cfg.modo==='rollo')return{w:Math.min(40,cfg.rolloW),h:Math.min(40,cfg.rolloH),cw:cfg.rolloW,ch:cfg.rolloH};
  const h=hoja();return{w:Math.min(40,h.w),h:Math.min(40,h.h),cw:h.w,ch:h.h}}
function labelHTML(it){
  const bx=stickerBox();const txt=2.9+(cfg.info?2.9:0)+(cfg.precio&&!cfg.info?2.9:0);
  const barH=Math.max(6,Math.min(18,bx.h-2-txt));
  const info=[];if(cfg.info){info.push(`<b>${esc(it.talle||'—')}</b> ${esc(it.nombre)}`)}if(cfg.precio)info.push(`<b>${money(it.precio)}</b>`);
  return`<div class="lbl" style="width:${bx.w}mm;height:${bx.h}mm">${barcodeSVG(it.code,bx.w-1.5,barH.toFixed(1),cfg.modo==='rollo')}<div class="l-code">${esc(it.code)}</div>${info.length?`<div class="l-info">${info.join(' · ')}</div>`:''}</div>`}
const colaOrdenada=()=>db.cola.filter(q=>itemById(q.itemId)).sort((a,b)=>{const x=itemById(a.itemId),y=itemById(b.itemId);return x.nombre.localeCompare(y.nombre)||String(x.color).localeCompare(y.color)||sizeOrd(x.talle)-sizeOrd(y.talle)});
function sheetMap(){const h=hoja();const st=Math.min(cfg.start,perSheet());let c='';for(let i=1;i<=h.cols*h.rows;i++)c+=`<i class="${i<st?'used':i===st?'next':''}"></i>`;
  return`<div class="sheetmap" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${h.cols},1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(${h.rows},1fr)" aria-label="Hoja: empieza en la etiqueta ${st}">${c}</div>`}
V.etiquetas=()=>{const cola=colaOrdenada();const n=cola.reduce((a,q)=>a+q.cant,0);const h=hoja();
  const sample=itemById(cola[0]?.itemId)||db.items[0]||{code:'10000001',nombre:'Remera básica',color:'Blanco',talle:'4',precio:18000};
  const bx=stickerBox();const hojas=cfg.modo==='a4'?Math.ceil((Math.min(cfg.start,perSheet())-1+n)/perSheet()):0;
  return`<div class="vhead"><div><h2>Etiquetas</h2><p>Stickers con el código de barras para pegar atrás de la etiqueta de cartón. Salen ordenados por prenda, color y talle.</p></div>
  <div class="row"><button class="btn" data-act="lbl-test">Hoja de prueba</button><button class="btn pri" data-act="lbl-print" ${n?'':'disabled'}>Imprimir ${n} sticker${n===1?'':'s'}${hojas?` (${hojas} hoja${hojas>1?'s':''})`:''}</button></div></div>
  <div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px;align-items:start">
   <div class="grid" style="gap:12px;min-width:0">
    <div class="row"><label class="f grow">Agregar prenda a la cola<span class="inrow"><input id="lq" placeholder="Escaneá o buscá…" autocomplete="off">${camBtn('lq')}</span></label><button class="btn" data-act="lbl-all">Todo el stock</button><button class="btn danger" data-act="lbl-clear" ${cola.length?'':'disabled'}>Vaciar</button></div>
    <div class="results" id="lres"></div>
    <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Prenda</th><th>Talle</th><th>Código</th><th>Cant.</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${cola.length?cola.map(q=>{const it=itemById(q.itemId);return`<tr><td class="item-name">${esc(fullName(it))}</td><td>${esc(it.talle||'—')}</td><td class="mono">${esc(it.code)}</td><td><input type="number" min="0" value="${q.cant}" data-lblq="${it.id}" style="width:72px" aria-label="Cantidad"></td><td><button class="btn sm ghost danger" data-act="lbl-del" data-id="${it.id}" aria-label="Quitar">✕</button></td></tr>`}).join('')
      :`<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No hay stickers pendientes. Cuando ingresás mercadería caen acá solos.</td></tr>`}
    </tbody></table></div>
   </div>
   <div class="panel grid" style="gap:14px">
    <h3>Cómo imprimís <span class="hint">(se guarda en este equipo)</span></h3>
    <div class="seg"><button data-act="lbl-modo" data-m="a4" aria-pressed="${cfg.modo==='a4'}">Impresora común · hoja A4</button><button data-act="lbl-modo" data-m="rollo" aria-pressed="${cfg.modo==='rollo'}">Impresora de etiquetas · rollo</button></div>
    ${cfg.modo==='a4'?`
    <label class="f">Hoja autoadhesiva<select id="cHoja">${Object.entries(HOJAS).map(([k,o])=>`<option value="${k}" ${cfg.hoja===k?'selected':''}>${o.n}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>
    ${cfg.hoja==='custom'?`<div class="grid g4" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))">${[['cols','Columnas'],['rows','Filas'],['w','Ancho mm'],['h','Alto mm'],['left','Margen izq.'],['top','Margen sup.'],['hp','Paso horiz.'],['vp','Paso vert.']].map(([k,l])=>`<label class="f">${l}<input type="number" step="0.1" min="0" data-cust="${k}" value="${cfg.custom[k]}"></label>`).join('')}</div>
      <span class="hint">El paso es la distancia desde el borde izquierdo de una etiqueta al de la siguiente (incluye el espacio entre ellas). Viene impreso en el paquete o se mide con regla.</span>`:''}
    <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start;gap:16px">${sheetMap()}
      <div class="grid" style="gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:150px"><label class="f">Empezar en la etiqueta N°<input type="number" min="1" max="${perSheet()}" id="cStart" value="${Math.min(cfg.start,perSheet())}"></label>
      <span class="hint">Para aprovechar una hoja que ya usaste. Se cuenta de izquierda a derecha y de arriba hacia abajo. Después de imprimir se actualiza sola.</span></div></div>`
    :`<div class="grid g2"><label class="f">Ancho del rollo (mm)<input type="number" min="20" max="40" id="cRW" value="${cfg.rolloW}"></label><label class="f">Alto del sticker (mm)<input type="number" min="12" max="40" id="cRH" value="${cfg.rolloH}"></label></div>
      <span class="hint">Medidas comunes de rollo: 40 × 20, 40 × 25 o 40 × 30 mm. En la configuración de la impresora elegí ese mismo tamaño de papel.</span>`}
    <div class="lbl-stage"><span class="hint">Así sale (aumentado). Sticker ${bx.w} × ${bx.h} mm${bx.cw>bx.w?` dentro de una etiqueta de ${bx.cw} mm`:''}</span><div class="zoom" style="--zh:${bx.h}mm">${labelHTML(sample)}</div></div>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cInfo" ${cfg.info?'checked':''}> Talle y nombre debajo del código <span class="hint">(recomendado)</span></label>
    <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="cPrecio" ${cfg.precio?'checked':''}> Precio</label>
    <span class="hint">Al imprimir: escala 100 % o "Tamaño real", márgenes "Ninguno" y sin encabezados ni pie de página.</span>
   </div>
  </div>`};
AFTER.etiquetas=()=>{
  const q=$('#lq');q.oninput=()=>{$('#lres').innerHTML=searchItems(q.value).map(it=>resBtn(it,'lbl-pick')).join('')};
  q.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){const it=itemByCode(q.value);if(it){queueLabels(it,1);commit();render();setTimeout(()=>$('#lq').focus())}}};
  $$('[data-lblq]').forEach(i=>i.onchange=()=>{setLabel(i.dataset.lblq,numIn(i.value));commit();setTimeout(render)});
  const on=(id,f)=>{const e=$('#'+id);if(e)e.addEventListener('change',()=>{f(e);saveCfg();setTimeout(render)})};
  on('cHoja',e=>{cfg.hoja=e.value;cfg.start=1});
  on('cStart',e=>{cfg.start=Math.max(1,Math.min(perSheet(),Math.round(numIn(e.value))||1))});
  on('cRW',e=>{cfg.rolloW=Math.max(20,Math.min(40,numIn(e.value)||40))});
  on('cRH',e=>{cfg.rolloH=Math.max(12,Math.min(40,numIn(e.value)||25))});
  on('cInfo',e=>{cfg.info=e.checked});on('cPrecio',e=>{cfg.precio=e.checked});
  $$('[data-cust]').forEach(i=>i.addEventListener('change',()=>{cfg.custom[i.dataset.cust]=Math.max(0,numIn(i.value));if(i.dataset.cust==='cols'||i.dataset.cust==='rows')cfg.custom[i.dataset.cust]=Math.max(1,Math.round(cfg.custom[i.dataset.cust]));cfg.start=1;saveCfg();setTimeout(render)}));
};
ACT['lbl-modo']=b=>{cfg.modo=b.dataset.m;saveCfg();render()};
ACT['lbl-pick']=b=>{queueLabels(itemById(b.dataset.id),1);commit();render();setTimeout(()=>$('#lq').focus())};
ACT['lbl-del']=b=>{setLabel(b.dataset.id,0);commit();render()};
ACT['lbl-clear']=()=>confirmBox('Vaciar la cola','Se quitan todos los stickers pendientes. Las prendas y el stock no se tocan.','Vaciar',()=>{db.cola.slice().forEach(q=>setLabel(q.itemId,0));commit();render()});
ACT['lbl-all']=()=>confirmBox('Stickers para todo el stock','Agrega un sticker por cada prenda en stock ('+db.items.reduce((a,i)=>a+Math.max(0,i.stock),0)+' en total). Sirve para la primera carga de la mercadería que ya está en el local.','Agregar',()=>{db.items.forEach(i=>{if(i.stock>0)setLabel(i.id,i.stock)});db.cola.slice().forEach(q=>{const it=itemById(q.itemId);if(!it||it.stock<=0)setLabel(q.itemId,0)});commit();render()},false);
/* arma las páginas: en A4 cada sticker va en su posición exacta de la hoja */
function printPages(list,test){
  if(cfg.modo==='rollo'){const bx=stickerBox();
    $('#pageStyle').textContent=`@page{size:${cfg.rolloW}mm ${cfg.rolloH}mm;margin:0}@media print{#print .rpage{width:${cfg.rolloW}mm;height:${cfg.rolloH}mm;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;break-after:page;page-break-after:always}#print .rpage:last-child{break-after:auto;page-break-after:auto}}`;
    return list.map(h=>`<div class="rpage">${h}</div>`).join('')}
  const s=hoja(),per=s.cols*s.rows;let pos=test?0:Math.min(cfg.start,per)-1;const pages=[];let cur=[];
  const cell=(i,html)=>{const c=i%s.cols,r=Math.floor(i/s.cols);return`<div class="cell" style="left:${(s.left+c*s.hp).toFixed(2)}mm;top:${(s.top+r*s.vp).toFixed(2)}mm;width:${s.w}mm;height:${s.h}mm">${html}</div>`};
  if(test){for(let i=0;i<per;i++)cur.push(cell(i,`<span class="tn">${i+1}</span>${i===0&&list[0]?list[0]:''}`));pages.push(cur)}
  else{for(const h of list){cur.push(cell(pos,h));pos++;if(pos>=per){pages.push(cur);cur=[];pos=0}}if(cur.length)pages.push(cur)}
  $('#pageStyle').textContent=`@page{size:210mm 297mm;margin:0}@media print{#print .sheet{position:relative;width:210mm;height:296.5mm;overflow:hidden;break-after:page;page-break-after:always}#print .sheet:last-child{break-after:auto;page-break-after:auto}#print .cell{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}${test?'#print .cell{outline:.2mm solid #999}#print .tn{position:absolute;left:1mm;top:.5mm;font:2.6mm Arial;color:#999}':''}}`;
  return pages.map(p=>`<div class="sheet">${p.join('')}</div>`).join('');
}
function doPrint(html,after){$('#print').innerHTML=html;setTimeout(()=>{window.print();if(after)setTimeout(after,400)},80)}
ACT['lbl-test']=()=>{const it=itemById(colaOrdenada()[0]?.itemId)||db.items[0];
  doPrint(printPages(it?[labelHTML(it)]:[],true),()=>modal(`<h3>Cómo usar la hoja de prueba</h3><p class="muted" style="margin:0">${cfg.modo==='a4'?'Imprimila en una hoja común, ponela contra la luz encima de una hoja de etiquetas y fijate que los recuadros coincidan. Si están corridos, elegí "Otra medida" y ajustá márgenes y pasos.':'Salió un sticker de muestra. Si salió cortado o corrido, revisá en la impresora que el tamaño de papel sea igual al del rollo.'}</p><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn pri" data-act="modal-close">Entendido</button></div>`))};
ACT['lbl-print']=()=>{
  const list=[];colaOrdenada().forEach(q=>{const it=itemById(q.itemId);const l=labelHTML(it);for(let k=0;k<q.cant;k++)list.push(l)});
  if(!list.length)return;const n=list.length;
  doPrint(printPages(list,false),()=>confirmBox('¿Salieron bien los stickers?','Si ya los imprimiste, vaciá la cola para que no se repitan la próxima vez.'+(cfg.modo==='a4'?' La próxima impresión arranca en la etiqueta '+(((Math.min(cfg.start,perSheet())-1+n)%perSheet())+1)+' de la hoja.':''),'Sí, vaciar cola',()=>{
    if(cfg.modo==='a4'){cfg.start=((Math.min(cfg.start,perSheet())-1+n)%perSheet())+1;saveCfg()}
    db.cola.slice().forEach(q=>setLabel(q.itemId,0));commit();render()},false));
};

/* ============ VENTAS ============ */
V.ventas=()=>{const[a,b]=rangeOf(per.ventas);const vs=db.ventas.filter(v=>new Date(v.fecha)>=a&&new Date(v.fecha)<b).sort((x,y)=>y.fecha.localeCompare(x.fecha));const ok=vs.filter(v=>!v.anulada);
  return`<div class="vhead"><div><h2>Ventas</h2><p>${ok.length} ventas · <b class="num">${money(ok.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.total,0))}</b> en el período.</p></div><button class="btn" data-act="exp-csv-ventas">Exportar a Excel (CSV)</button></div>
  ${perBar('ventas')}
  <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Fecha</th><th>Prendas</th><th>Pago</th><th class="r">Desc.</th><th class="r">Total</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${vs.length?vs.map(v=>`<tr style="${v.anulada?'opacity:.55':''}"><td class="mono">${esc(v.nro)}</td><td class="num">${fdate(v.fecha)} ${ftime(v.fecha)}</td>
   <td>${v.items.map(l=>`${l.cant}× ${esc(l.nombre)} <span class="muted">${esc(l.talle||'')}</span>`).join('<br>')}</td>
   <td>${esc(v.pago)}</td><td class="r num">${v.desc?money(v.desc):''}</td><td class="r num"><b>${money(v.total)}</b></td>
   <td>${v.anulada?'<span class="pill bad">Anulada</span>':`<button class="btn sm danger" data-act="venta-anular" data-id="${v.id}">Anular</button>`}</td></tr>`).join('')
   :`<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">No hay ventas en este período.</td></tr>`}</tbody></table></div>`};
ACT['venta-anular']=b=>{const v=db.ventas.find(x=>x.id===b.dataset.id);
  confirmBox('Anular venta #'+v.nro,'Se devuelven al stock las prendas ('+v.items.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.cant,0)+') y se descuenta '+money(v.total)+' de los ingresos. Usalo para errores o devoluciones.','Anular venta',()=>{
   v.anulada=true;w('ventas',v.id,{anulada:true});
   v.items.forEach(l=>{const it=itemById(l.itemId);if(it){it.stock+=l.cant;w('items',it.id,{},{inc:{stock:l.cant}});addMov({itemId:it.id,tipo:'anulación',cant:l.cant,costo:l.costo,ventaId:v.id})}});commit();render();toast('Venta anulada y stock devuelto')})};

/* ============ INGRESOS ============ */
function barChart(buckets){
  const W=720,H=220,pl=58,pb=24,pt=10,max=Math.max(1,...buckets.map(b=>b.v));
  const step=(()=>{const raw=max/4,p=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)));return[1,2,2.5,5,10].map(m=>m*p).find(s=>s>=raw)})();
  const top=step*Math.ceil(max/step);const bw=(W-pl-8)/buckets.length;const y=v=>pt+(H-pt-pb)*(1-v/top);
  let g='';for(let t=0;t<=top+1e-9;t+=step){g+=`<line x1="${pl}" x2="${W-4}" y1="${y(t)}" y2="${y(t)}" stroke="var(--line)"/><text x="${pl-6}" y="${y(t)+3}" text-anchor="end">${t>=1e6?(t/1e6).toLocaleString('es-AR')+' M':t>=1e3?(t/1e3).toLocaleString('es-AR')+' k':t}</text>`}
  const every=Math.ceil(buckets.length/12);
  const bars=buckets.map((b,i)=>{const x=pl+i*bw+bw*.15,w=Math.max(1,bw*.7);return`<rect x="${x}" y="${y(b.v)}" width="${w}" height="${Math.max(0,H-pb-y(b.v))}" rx="2" fill="var(--accent)"><title>${b.l}: ${money(b.v)}</title></rect>${i%every===0?`<text x="${x+w/2}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle">${b.l}</text>`:''}`}).join('');
  return`<div class="chart"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Ingresos por período">${g}${bars}</svg></div>`;
}
function hbars(rows){const m=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r[1]));return`<div class="bars-h">${rows.map(([l,v,s])=>`<div class="bh"><span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">${esc(l)}</span><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:${v/m*100}%"></div></div><span class="val">${money(v)}${s?`<br><span class="muted" style="font-size:.75rem">${s}</span>`:''}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="muted">Sin datos en este período.</div>'}</div>`}
V.informes=()=>{
  const[a,b]=rangeOf(per.informes);const vs=ventasEn(a,b);
  const bruto=vs.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.total,0),costo=vs.reduce((s,v)=>s+cmv(v),0),desc=vs.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.desc,0),un=vs.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.items.reduce((x,l)=>x+l.cant,0),0);
  const gastos=db.gastos.filter(g=>new Date(g.fecha)>=a&&new Date(g.fecha)<b).reduce((s,g)=>s+g.monto,0);
  const margen=bruto-costo,res=margen-gastos;
  const days=Math.round((b-a)/864e5);const byMonth=days>62;const bk=[];
  if(byMonth){let d=new Date(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth(),1);while(d<b){const n=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth()+1,1);bk.push({a:d,b:n,l:d.toLocaleDateString('es-AR',{month:'short'})+' '+String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2),v:0});d=n}}
  else{let d=new Date(a);while(d<b){const n=new Date(d);n.setDate(d.getDate()+1);bk.push({a:new Date(d),b:n,l:pad(d.getDate())+'/'+pad(d.getMonth()+1),v:0});d=n}}
  vs.forEach(v=>{const t=new Date(v.fecha);const k=bk.find(x=>t>=x.a&&t<x.b);if(k)k.v+=v.total});
  const pago={};vs.forEach(v=>pago[v.pago]=(pago[v.pago]||0)+v.total);
  const cat={},top={};vs.forEach(v=>v.items.forEach(l=>{const it=itemById(l.itemId);const c=(it&&it.categoria)||'Sin categoría';const imp=l.cant*l.precio*(v.subtotal?v.total/v.subtotal:1);
    cat[c]=(cat[c]||0)+imp;top[l.nombre]=top[l.nombre]||{v:0,u:0};top[l.nombre].v+=imp;top[l.nombre].u+=l.cant}));
  return`<div class="vhead"><div><h2>Ingresos</h2><p>Ingresos brutos son lo cobrado en ventas, ya con descuentos. El margen resta lo que te costó la mercadería vendida.</p></div></div>
  ${perBar('informes')}
  <div class="kpis">
